about: Announced value-accrual plans (fee switches, buybacks, burns, revenue sharing) for the Fundamentals Checklist's fee-switch check. Edit by hand or in the dashboard's Settings panel (your edits there override this file for you only). Every entry needs a source link (http or https) and the date you last checked it. Only record plans you have confirmed from a primary source, such as a passed governance vote or an official announcement.

fields.protocol: the DefiLlama slug from config/watchlist.json, e.g. aave
fields.what: one plain sentence on what was announced
fields.source: link to the proposal, vote or announcement
